ROW.COLUMN: (FR/CU) Anomalies in ATM, Bank Card: Foreign Transactions

Bank/Debit cards can be easily utilized at ATMs to transfer assets to other individuals or locations due to the anonymity afforded to ATM users. Deposits can be made into accounts in any number of ways and then be removed as currency from almost any location. A sudden increase in ATM withdrawals, or change in the location of ATMs used may indicate account takeover or the attempted movement of funds that have been defrauded out of the institution. Sudden increases in the activity at a certain location may indicate fraudsters' use of skimmed or compromised Bank/Debit cards. This scenario monitors foreign ATM withdrawal activity that is unusual for a particular customer or account and could be indicative of fraudulent activity, such as an organized crime ring attempting to move defrauded funds offshore.
SELECT a.HH_ACCT_GRP_ID, a.ACCT_INTRL_ID, a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID, b.EMP_ACCT_SEQ_ID FROM @BUSINESS@.ACCT a inner join @BUSINESS@.EMP_ACCT b on (a.ACCT_INTRL_ID=b.ACCT_INTRL_ID)
SELECT a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID, a.ACCT_INTRL_ID, b.ACCT_BAL_SEQ_ID, a.HH_ACCT_GRP_ID FROM @BUSINESS@.ACCT a inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT_BAL_POSN_SMRY b on (a.ACCT_INTRL_ID=b.ACCT_INTRL_ID)

SELECT a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID, b.ACCT_INTRL_ID, a.HH_ACCT_GRP_ID, c.NVSMT_MGR_SEQ_ID FROM @BUSINESS@.NVSMT_MGR c inner join @BUSINESS@.MANGD_ACCT b inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT a on (b.ACCT_INTRL_ID=a.ACCT_INTRL_ID) on (c.NVSMT_MGR_INTRL_ID=b.NVSMT_MGR_INTRL_ID)

-- 10/15/2004 SELECT g.CUST_INTRL_ID , g.CUST_SEQ_ID , g.Effctv_Risk_Lvl , g.Actvty_Risk_Lvl , g.Tot_Trans_Amt , g.Tot_Trans_Ct , g.Loc_Ct , g.Trxn_Base_Am_Frgn , g.Trxn_Base_Ct_Frgn , case when g.Trxn_Base_Am_Frgn = 0 then 0 else g.Hr_Trans_Amt/g.Trxn_Base_Am_Frgn*100 end as Hr_Prctg , case when g.Trxn_Base_Am_Frgn = 0 then 0 else g.Lrf_Trans_Amt/g.Trxn_Base_Am_Frgn*100 end as Lrf_Prctg , g.Trxn_Base_Am_Frgn/g.Tot_Trans_Amt*100 as Trxn_Am_Frgn_Prctg , g.Overall_Risk
FROM ( SELECT trxn.CUST_INTRL_ID, max(trxn.CUST_SEQ_ID) as CUST_SEQ_ID, sum(trxn.TRXN_BASE_AM) as Tot_Trans_Amt, max(trxn.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB) as Effctv_Risk_Lvl, sum(case when (trxn.ADDR_CNTRY_CD_1 <> trxn.ADDR_CNTRY_CD_2) then trxn.TRXN_BASE_AM else 0 end) as Trxn_Base_Am_Frgn, sum(case when (trxn.ADDR_CNTRY_CD_1 <> trxn.ADDR_CNTRY_CD_2) then 1 else 0 end) as Trxn_Base_Ct_Frgn, count(1) as Tot_Trans_Ct, count(distinct (case when (trxn.ADDR_CNTRY_CD_1 <> trxn.ADDR_CNTRY_CD_2) then trxn.TRXN_LOC_ID else null end)) as Loc_Ct, sum(case when ((trxn.TRXN_BASE_AM - TRUNC(trxn.TRXN_BASE_AM,-@Lrf_Digits)) = 0) then trxn.TRXN_BASE_AM when ((trxn.TRXN_ACTVY_AM - TRUNC(trxn.TRXN_ACTVY_AM,-@Lrf_Digits)) = 0) THEN trxn.TRXN_BASE_AM else 0 end) as Lrf_Trans_Amt, sum(case when trxn.CASH_TRXN_ACTVY_RISK_NB > @Actvty_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl then trxn.TRXN_BASE_AM else 0 end) as Hr_Trans_Amt, max(trxn.CASH_TRXN_ACTVY_RISK_NB) as Actvty_Risk_Lvl, case when max(trxn.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB)>= @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl and max(trxn.CASH_TRXN_ACTVY_RISK_NB) >= @Actvty_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl then 'HR' when max(trxn.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB)< @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl and max(trxn.CASH_TRXN_ACTVY_RISK_NB) < @Actvty_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl then 'RR' else 'MR' end Overall_Risk FROM ( SELECT distinct c.CUST_INTRL_ID, c.CUST_SEQ_ID, ct1.TRXN_BASE_AM, c.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB, d.ADDR_CNTRY_CD as ADDR_CNTRY_CD_1, aa.ADDR_CNTRY_CD as ADDR_CNTRY_CD_2, ct1.TRXN_LOC_ID, ct1.TRXN_ACTVY_AM, ct1.CASH_TRXN_NTITY_RISK_NB, ct1.CASH_TRXN_ACTVY_RISK_NB, ct1.DATA_DUMP_DT, a.ACCT_INTRL_ID, ct1.fo_trxn_seq_id FROM @BUSINESS@.CASH_TRXN ct1 inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT a on ct1.acct_intrl_id = a.acct_intrl_id inner join @BUSINESS@.CUST c on a.prmry_cust_intrl_id = c.cust_intrl_id inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT_ADDR aa on a.acct_intrl_id = aa.acct_intrl_id inner join @BUSINESS@.DERIVED_ADDRESS d on ct1.trxn_loc_addr_seq_id = d.dervd_addr_seq_id
WHERE -- Include Customer Retail Accounts Only a.mantas_acct_holdr_type_cd = 'CR' -- Exclude Exempted Customers and c.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 -- Exclude Distribution, Dividend, Fee, Interest, and Transfer-Of-Account Transactions and ct1.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' and ct1.MANTAS_TRXN_PRDCT_CD in (@Incl_Cash_Trxn_Prdct_Type_Lst) -- Include ATM Withdrawal/Outgoing/Debit Transactions Only and ct1.DBT_CDT_CD = 'D' and ct1.mantas_trxn_chanl_cd in ('ATM') ------------------------------------------------------------------------- and a.mantas_acct_bus_type_cd in (@Mantas_Bus_Acct_Type_Lst) and (@All_Trans_Src_Fl = 'Y' or ct1.src_sys_cd in (@Incl_Trans_Src_Lst)) and (@All_Jurisdictions_Fl='Y' or c.JRSDCN_CD in (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst)) --and aa.addr_cntry_cd <> d.addr_cntry_cd --and ct1.TRXN_BASE_AM > 0 ------------------------------------------------------------------------- and ct1.trxn_exctn_dt <= (select b.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_cal b where b.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL'and b.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) and ct1.trxn_exctn_dt > (select add_days(b.CLNDR_DT, - @Look_Back_Period) from @MANTAS@.KDD_cal b where b.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL'and b.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) and ct1.DATA_DUMP_DT <= (select b.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_cal b where b.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL'and b.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) and ct1.DATA_DUMP_DT > (select add_days(b.CLNDR_DT, - @Look_Back_Period) from @MANTAS@.KDD_cal b where b.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL'and b.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) ) trxn GROUP BY trxn.cust_intrl_id having -- Frequency_Period Period --PR33796 max(case when (trxn.ADDR_CNTRY_CD_1 <> trxn.ADDR_CNTRY_CD_2) then trxn.DATA_DUMP_DT else f_char_to_date('01011901','MMDDYYYY') end ) <= (select b.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_cal b where b.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and b.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) and max(case when (trxn.ADDR_CNTRY_CD_1 <> trxn.ADDR_CNTRY_CD_2) then trxn.DATA_DUMP_DT else f_char_to_date('01011901','MMDDYYYY') end ) > (select add_days(b.CLNDR_DT, - @Frequency_Period) from @MANTAS@.KDD_cal b where b.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and b.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) -- Exclude Customer Containing only one account and count(distinct(trxn.acct_intrl_id)) >= @Min_Acct_Ct ) g WHERE
( g.Overall_Risk = 'HR' and g.Trxn_Base_Ct_Frgn >= @HR_Min_Number_of_Foreign_WD and g.Trxn_Base_Am_Frgn/g.Tot_Trans_Amt*100 >= @HR_Pct_Foreign_WD_Amt and g.Loc_Ct >= @HR_Min_Number_of_Dist_Locations ) or ( g.Overall_Risk = 'MR' and g.Trxn_Base_Ct_Frgn >= @MR_Min_Number_of_Foreign_WD and g.Trxn_Base_Am_Frgn/g.Tot_Trans_Amt*100 >= @MR_Pct_Foreign_WD_Amt and g.Loc_Ct >= @MR_Min_Number_of_Dist_Locations ) or ( g.Overall_Risk = 'RR' and g.Trxn_Base_Ct_Frgn >= @RR_Min_Number_of_Foreign_WD and g.Trxn_Base_Am_Frgn/g.Tot_Trans_Amt*100 >= @RR_Pct_Foreign_WD_Amt and g.Loc_Ct >= @RR_Min_Number_of_Dist_Locations )

SELECT distinct ct1.FO_TRXN_SEQ_ID , a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID as CUST_INTRL_ID FROM @BUSINESS@.CASH_TRXN ct1 inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT a on ct1.ACCT_INTRL_ID=a.ACCT_INTRL_ID inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT_ADDR aa on a.acct_intrl_id = aa.acct_intrl_id inner join @BUSINESS@.DERIVED_ADDRESS d on ct1.trxn_loc_addr_seq_id = d.dervd_addr_seq_id WHERE ct1.trxn_exctn_dt <= (select b.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_cal b where b.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL'and b.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) and ct1.trxn_exctn_dt > (select add_days(b.CLNDR_DT, - @Look_Back_Period) from @MANTAS@.KDD_cal b where b.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL'and b.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) and ct1.DATA_DUMP_DT <= (select b.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_cal b where b.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL'and b.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) and ct1.DATA_DUMP_DT > (select add_days(b.CLNDR_DT, - @Look_Back_Period) from @MANTAS@.KDD_cal b where b.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL'and b.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) -- Include ATM Withdrawal/Outgoing/Debit Transactions Only and ct1.DBT_CDT_CD='D' and ct1.MANTAS_TRXN_CHANL_CD = 'ATM' -- Include Customer Retail Accounts Only and a.MANTAS_ACCT_HOLDR_TYPE_CD = 'CR' -- ------------------------------------------------------- and a.MANTAS_ACCT_BUS_TYPE_CD in (@Mantas_Bus_Acct_Type_Lst) -- Exclude Distribution, Dividend, Fee, Interest, and Transfer-Of-Account Transactions and ct1.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' and ct1.MANTAS_TRXN_PRDCT_CD in (@Incl_Cash_Trxn_Prdct_Type_Lst) and (@All_Trans_Src_Fl='Y' or ct1.SRC_SYS_CD in (@Incl_Trans_Src_Lst)) -- Include only Foreign transactions and aa.addr_cntry_cd <> d.addr_cntry_cd and ct1.TRXN_BASE_AM > 0
